formats.key: Request(address tokenIn,uint256 amountIn,Output[] outputs,uint256 deadline,uint256 nonce,address protocol)Output(address token,uint256 amount,address recipient)
effects: When an order built on this request is filled, exactly amountIn of tokenIn is pulled from the signer (swapper) by Reactor through an existing ERC-20 allowance and sent to the LiquidLane adapter(s) the filler picks.

Each output recipient gets at least outputs[i].amount of outputs[i].token (zero address = native ETH), paid by the filler. The amount is whatever the protocol-signed Order says, as long as it is at least the request minimum.
The signer's request nonce is marked used, so this request can be filled only once.
The request is only valid until the deadline and only through an Order signed by the named protocol signer, which also picks the filler.
formats.shown: "Swap {amountIn} for at least {outputs}", plus fields for input token, exact input, each minimum output paired with its recipient, deadline, nonce and protocol signer.

findings.title: Request: the intent sentence leaves out the output recipients, who may not be the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Swap {amountIn} for at least {outputs.[].amount}". Reactor.sol _fill sends each output to order.outputs[i].recipient (safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, order.outputs[i].recipient, ...) / sendValue). Cases 1 and 3 send outputs to two different recipients (e.g. 0.05 ETH to 0x8594…41E9). The recipients only appear as 'Output recipient' fields.
findings.fix: Add the recipient to the sentence, e.g. "Swap {amountIn} for at least {outputs.[].amount} to {outputs.[].recipient}", or say "sent to the listed recipients".

findings.title: Request: the adapters that receive the signer's input are picked at fill time and are not in the message.
findings.evidence: Reactor.sol _fill: IERC20(order.request.tokenIn).safeTransferFrom(order.swapper, swapInputs[i].adapter, swapInputs[i].swap.amountIn). The adapter comes from the filler's calldata and is only checked against IRegistry(LIQUID_LANE_ADAPTER_FACTORY).isEntity.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. A short note that the input goes to registered LiquidLane adapters would help.

findings.title: Request: the 'Input token' field shows a raw address that 'Exact input' already names by symbol.
findings.evidence: Field #.tokenIn uses addressName with sources local/ens, and case 0 renders it as 0xC26A6Fa2C37b38E549a4a1807543801Db684f99C, while 'Exact input' shows '1 AA_FalconXUSDC'.
findings.fix: Fine to keep it for verification. Otherwise drop it, or rely on the tokenAmount rendering.

formats.key: Order(Request request,bytes swapperSignature,address swapper,address filler,Output[] outputs)Output(address token,uint256 amount,address recipient)Request(address tokenIn,uint256 amountIn,Output[] outputs,uint256 deadline,uint256 nonce,address protocol)
effects: The signer is the protocol signer. Signing lets exactly one filler address call Reactor.fill to settle the swapper's signed request. None of the signer's own assets move.
The fill pulls exactly request.amountIn of request.tokenIn from the swapper and sends it to adapters.

The filler must deliver exactly order.outputs[i].amount of each output token to each recipient. Token, recipient and order must match the request, and each amount must be at least the request minimum.
Any ETH left in Reactor after the fill goes back to the filler. Signing also binds the hash of the swapper's signature and uses up the swapper's nonce.
formats.shown: "Authorize {filler} to swap {request.amountIn} for {outputs} (minimum {request outputs})", plus fields for swapper, filler, input token and amount, request minimums with recipients, deadline, nonce, protocol signer, and authorized outputs with recipients. The swapper signature is hidden.

findings.title: Order: the intent sentence does not say whose tokens the filler swaps or who receives the outputs.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent "Authorize {filler} to swap {request.amountIn} for {outputs.[].amount} (minimum ...)". Reactor.sol _fill pulls the input from order.swapper and pays outputs to order.outputs[i].recipient. In case 4 the swapper is 0x2ED2…384C and the recipients are 0xd560…Ab5b and 0x8594…41E9. These appear only as fields.
findings.fix: Use e.g. "Authorize {filler} to swap {request.amountIn} from {swapper} for {outputs.[].amount} to {outputs.[].recipient} (minimum ...)".

findings.title: Order: the adapters that receive the swapper's input are not in the signed message.
findings.evidence: Reactor.sol _fill: safeTransferFrom(order.swapper, swapInputs[i].adapter, ...). The adapter comes from fill calldata and is checked only by IRegistry.isEntity.
